title: PrimaLuce AP mode ignores a negative command acknowledgement
summary: set_access_point returns transport/verb success even for nested AP_SET_STATUS Error text. GIOTTO/ALTO/focuser consumers memoize the requested switch and publish OK while readback only changes separate status. Validate named acknowledgement and retain rejection error before memoizing state; use existing simulator refusal fixtures. Related credential/reboot acknowledgement handling is follow-up within this family. Next action: coordinator assigns a focused repair and relevant regression.
